AN INCREDIBLY SIMPLE IDEA TO EXECUTE! FROM $2,500+ PER SINGLE PROJECT MADE WITH CLAUDE

While everyone else is using AI just to write copy, you can build a completely different business with it.

The playbook is as simple as it gets.

Open Google Maps.

Find beauty salons, dental clinics, auto repair shops, restaurants, fitness clubs, law firms. Any local business.

From there, you have two options.

First.

The business has no website at all.

Second.

They have a website, but it looks like it was built ten years ago.

These are exactly the kinds of websites you can completely redesign using Claude in literally just a few hours.

And the best part is, you don’t need to be a designer or a programmer at all.

In most cases, you just need to take all the information from the old website.

The copy.

The services.

The pricing.

The contacts.

The reviews.

Feed Claude the link or screenshots of the old site and explain what you want to get.

For example:

“Create a modern, high-converting website. Completely overhaul the structure, make a beautiful design, add high-quality sections, strong calls to action, modern animations, and a smooth mobile version. But keep all the information from the current site.”

Essentially, the information stays the same.

Only the packaging changes.

And packaging is often exactly what decides whether a person buys a service or closes the tab after five seconds.

If they don’t have a website at all, the task isn't much harder.

Find a few of the best competitor websites.
Take the most successful ideas.

Add the client’s logo, their services, contacts, brand colors, upload a few high-quality stock photos, and ask Claude to put it all together into one modern website.

If you have a good eye for design, you can add your own ideas and make the result even stronger.

But even without that, Claude can deliver a level of quality that just a couple of years ago would have required dozens of hours of work.

Now, here’s the most interesting part.

Most people sell promises.

They pitch a business owner and say:

“We can build you a good website.”

That’s a weak offer.

It’s much more powerful to show up with a ready-made solution.

Don't tell them.

Show them.

“This is what your company’s website could look like.”

When a person sees the result with their own eyes, selling becomes clicks easier.

Especially if their current website is actively scaring clients away.

In many regions, businesses are ready to pay thousands of dollars for projects like this. The ticket size depends on the country, the niche, and the quality of your work.

And while building websites like this used to take weeks, today Claude cuts that work down to just a few hours.

In my opinion, this is one of the most underrated AI opportunities right now.
